{{Term/Store|Silver Arrow|Silver Arrows|Series, TLoZ, ALttP|plural}} are recurring [[Item]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}.<ref>{{Cite Book|quote= |book= E |publisher= |page= 138 {{Exp Game|TLoZ}}}}</ref><ref name="Faerie">{{Cite|You are an honest person. I like you. I will give you something important... These are the Silver Arrows. To give Ganon his last moment, you definitely need them! I know I don't quite have the figure of a faerie. Ganon's cruel power is to blame! You must defeat Ganon!|Cursed Fairy|ALttP}}</ref>{{Note|In {{ALttP}}, the Item appears on the [[Sub Screen]] as '''Bow & Silver Arrows'''.}}

==Location and Uses==
Silver Arrows are powerful [[Arrow]]s used to defeat [[Ganon]] in {{TLoZ}} and {{ALttP}}. In the games they appeared in, they are the only weapon that is capable of defeating Ganon, who will recover from any wound if not pierced by a Silver Arrow.<ref name="Faerie"/> In later games of the series after {{ALttP|-}}, the [[Light Arrow]]s perform a similar role, although they function the complete opposite in that they merely stun Ganon, not to destroy him (although in some games they can instantly kill regular [[Enemy|Enemies]] like Silver Arrows did); The [[Master Sword]] is usually used to deal the final blow instead. Aside from one occasion in {{OoS}} and {{OoA}} where Ganon was not fully revived, the Silver Arrows are the only weapon shown to completely destroy Ganon in his demonic beast form.

==={{TLoZ|-}}===
{{Descriptions TLoZ}}
In {{TLoZ}}, the Silver Arrow is found in [[Level 9]] of both the First Quest and the [[Second Quest]]. After hitting [[Ganon]] 15 times with the [[Sword]], 8 times with the [[White Sword]] or 4 times with the [[Magical Sword]], [[Link]] must use a Silver Arrow to finish him off.<ref>{{Cite Manual| quote= Link's no match for Ganon and his might. Whatever attack Link uses, Ganon just repels him. But if Link could only use the magical sword and some other object, he'll manage to topple the mighty Ganon. ''Other object''? What's that?| game= TLoZ| page= 39}}</ref> These Arrows also deal double the damage of a normal Arrow to [[Enemy|Enemies]].

==={{ALttP|-}}===
In {{ALttP}}, Silver Arrows are given to [[Link]] by the [[Cursed Fairy]] inside the [[Pyramid of Power]], once the way has been opened with a [[Super Bomb]].<ref name="Faerie"/> They are more powerful versions of the typical arrows Link obtains, and are the strongest [[Weapon]] in the game, outclassing the [[Master Sword Lv3]] in raw power. When used as Weapons in the field, they can kill most [[Enemy|Enemies]] with a single shot, including some [[Boss]]es. Keeping in tradition with the original Zelda game, the Silver Arrows are used to kill [[Ganon]], although it takes four shots to finally defeat him.<ref name="Faerie"/>

==Other Appearances==
==={{AST|-}}===
{{Noncanon|Start}}
In {{AST}}, the Silver Arrows are foretold to be buried on [[Death Mountain]], and appear from a [[Hylian]] Monolith that also seals away [[Ganon's Tower]] from the world. They carry the same purpose and function as previous titles.
{{Noncanon|End}}

==={{TLoZ (Valiant Comics)|Display}}===
{{Noncanon|Start}}
[[File:Silver Arrow (VC).png|thumb|left|110px|The Silver Arrow, as seen in the comic]]
The Silver Arrow is also featured in two stories of {{TLoZ (Valiant Comics)}}, and in both appearances, [[Princess Zelda]] is the one to wield it with [[Zelda's Bow|her bow]]. In ''[[Day of the Triforce]]'', Princess Zelda decides to go attack and defeat [[Ganon]] once and for all since he is now powerless.<ref>{{Cite Book|quote=Relax, Impa... It's not as bad as all that. If ALL three Triforces are gone, then the evil wizard Gannon is bereft of the Triforce of Power. He will not attack us without it. Look upon today as a rare day of...PEACE.|book= TLoZ (Valiant Comics)|publisher= |page=1}}</ref> Once she reaches [[Death Mountain]] to challenge Ganon, she finds the powerless Ganon in his throne. Just as she is about to shoot him with the Silver Arrow, she hears a cry for help in another room and cannot help but to go and aid said person instead.<ref>{{Cite Book|quote=What's that? A cry for help! Surely you cannot ignore some innocent in danger!|book= TLoZ (Valiant Comics)|publisher= |page=7}}</ref><ref>{{Cite Book|quote=Curse you, Ganon! This isn't over yet!|book= TLoZ (Valiant Comics)|publisher= |page=7}}</ref>

In ''[[Choices]]'', Zelda finds the Silver Arrow on a small pedestal after defeating a [[Darknut]] inside Death Mountain.<ref>{{Cite Book|quote=A Silver Arrow...of course! I remember!|book= TLoZ (Valiant Comics)|publisher= |page=4}}</ref> She then recalls what Impa told her that if Zelda's heart is true, the Triforce of Wisdom will help her use the Silver Arrow to destroy Ganon.<ref>{{Cite Book|quote=Find a Silver Arrow. If your heart is true, the Triforce will help you use it to destroy Ganon.|book= TLoZ (Valiant Comics)|publisher= |page=4}}</ref> When the princess finds Ganon, she quickly readies a Silver Arrow to shoot at him,<ref>{{Cite Book|quote=Ganon, the only thing you're going to get is Justice!|book= TLoZ (Valiant Comics)|publisher= |page=9}}</ref> but before she has a chance to release it at the Prince of Darkness to defeat him, Link comes crashing in, giving Ganon a chance to escape.<ref>{{Cite Book|quote=Bah! I will choose my OWN time to deal with you! The game is not yet over!|book= TLoZ (Valiant Comics)|publisher= |page=10}}</ref>
{{Clear}}
{{Noncanon|End}}

==={{ALttP|-}} (Ishinomori)===
{{Noncanon|Start}}
[[File:Silver Arrow 2 (comic).png|thumb|right|75px|The Silver Arrow in the {{ALttP|-}} comic]]
In the {{ALttP (Ishinomori)}}, [[Roam]] reveals that he is seeking the Silver Arrow spoken of in the [[Book of Mudora]], which mentions that [[Ganon|the one]] who corrupts the [[Sacred Realm|Golden Land]] will be defeated with the sacred [[Arrow]].<ref>{{Cite Book|quote=It is written in the Book of Mudora: 'He who corrupts the land of gold shall fall to the shaft of the enchanted arrow of silver...' My family has always excelled in archery, and it is my destiny to destroy Ganon! I have not yet obtained the enchanted arrow, but...|book= ALttP (Ishinomori)|publisher= |page=4}}</ref> Although he reveals to Link that he has yet to find it, Roam continues to search for the Silver Arrow to defeat Ganon with it and prove himself to be the legendary hero.<ref>{{Cite Book|quote=Admit it, Link. It seems to support the Book of Mudora's prophecy that only the enchanted arrow can defeat the one who corrupted this world. You are '''stubborn''' and '''foolish'''... '''I''' will defeat Ganon!|book= ALttP (Ishinomori)|publisher= |page=6}}</ref> However, when [[Link]] and [[Zelda]] arrive to [[Ganon's Tower]], Roam suddenly appears and admits he has failed to find the Silver Arrows, and enters the tower with the young hero and the princess. Inside, after Roam dies saving Zelda, the princess uses Roam's crossbow to shoot an ordinary Arrow at Ganon. As it approaches Ganon, the power of the [[Maiden]]s, Zelda, Link, and Roam, turn the Arrow into the Silver Arrow,<ref>{{Cite Book|quote=It was the '''enchanted arrow'''...|book= ALttP (Ishinomori)|publisher= |page=6}}</ref> destroying the King of Thieves.
{{Noncanon|End}}

==={{ALttP|-}} (Himekawa)===
{{Noncanon|Start}}
In the {{ALttP (Himekawa)}}, the heads of the Silver Arrows are an heirloom of the [[Knights of Hyrule]].<ref name=manga>{{Cite Book|quote=Yes. Ghanti is a Hylian too. And this is the Silver Arrow passed from the Knights of Hyrule. It can pierce any evil. |book= ALttP (Himekawa)|publisher= |page=153}}</ref> Their only known living descendant, the young thief [[Ghanti]], wore them as earrings, unaware of their true purpose. This fact is revealed to her by [[Princess Zelda]] shortly after she recovered from the wounds she sustained as [[Trinexx]],<ref name=manga/> causing the young thief to change her views on the Knights. She later uses the Arrows to aid [[Link]] in his battle against Ganon, and with them, deals the finishing blow.
{{Noncanon|End}}

==={{HW|-}}===
{{Noncanon|Start}}
{{Main|Goddess Blade}}
In {{HW}}' Master Quest DLC pack, the [[8-Bit Silver Arrow]] from {{TLoZ}} appears as a [[Weapon]] for [[Fi]]. It is statistically identical to and part of the [[Goddess Blade]] Weapon type.
{{Clear}}
{{Noncanon|End}}

==Trivia==
*The Silver Arrows' function as [[Ganon]]'s only weakness is similar to more modern {{Wp|werewolf}} legends, in which a silver bullet is the only weapon that can kill a werewolf. This may be because silver was considered a holy element in many cultures.
